# LoomInspection

The state of a loom: its shape, what is held close, what is fading, and what the night last did.

**Kind:** an object, used in responses.

## Fields

Every field is present in a response; empty ones are `null`.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `loom` | [`Loom`](loom.md) | The loom itself. |
| `tally` | [`LoomTally`](loom-tally.md) | How many threads the loom holds, by strand, kind and state. |
| `pinned` | [`LoomThread`](loom-thread.md)`[]` | Threads held close (up to 10, heaviest first): always part of what an agent wakes up knowing. |
| `recentlyAccessed` | [`LoomThread`](loom-thread.md)`[]` | The threads most recently recalled or used (up to 5). |
| `highWeightDormant` | [`LoomThread`](loom-thread.md)`[]` | Important threads (weight 0.7 or more) that have gone unused for over 30 days (up to 5). |
| `fraying` | [`LoomThread`](loom-thread.md)`[]` | Threads loosening through disuse (up to 5, the most frayed first). |
| `openTensions` | [`LoomTensionView`](loom-tension-view.md)`[]` | Pairs of threads that pull against each other and have not been resolved (up to 5). |
| `lastNightWeaving` | [`NightWeaving`](night-weaving.md)`\| null` | The most recent night weaving of this loom that completed. Null if none has. |
| `panelSubjects` | `string[]` | The subjects (people and things) the tapestry has a panel about. |
| `patterns` | `string[]` | The codebases this loom keeps a pattern for. |
